app_fee.value: The application fee is $125 (nonrefundable) for every graduate program.
app_fee.quote: The application fee is $125 and is nonrefundable.

fee_waiver.value: School-based fee waivers exist for applicants with financial need; priority goes to US/domestic applicants and international PhD applicants are reviewed case by case. Request it at least 10 business days before your program's deadline.
fee_waiver.quote: International applicants are eligible to apply, but will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

also.quote: International students applying to doctoral programs will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.
U.S. citizens or permanent residents who have received a GRE Fee Reduction Voucher from ETS | 10 business days (two weeks) before application deadline

gre_general.value: Each Stanford program sets its own GRE policy (required, optional or not considered); see the program record.
gre_general.quote: Each graduate program sets its own policy on GRE General Test and GRE Subject Test scores — required, optional, or not considered.

toefl_min.value: University minimum is TOEFL iBT 90 (tests before 21 Jan 2026) or 4.5 on the new scale (tests from 21 Jan 2026). Below 109 / 5.5 you take the English Placement Test on arrival; programs may set higher minimums.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL (Taken before January 21, 2026) TOEFL (Taken on or after January 21, 2026) IELTS Minimum Score for Admission Consideration* 90 4.5 7

also.quote: Each graduate program may set a higher minimum score for admission consideration as appropriate for the specific field of study.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7 overall is the university minimum (8 exempts you from the English Placement Test).
ielts_min.quote: TOEFL (Taken before January 21, 2026) TOEFL (Taken on or after January 21, 2026) IELTS Minimum Score for Admission Consideration* 90 4.5 7

english_waiver.value: No English test is needed if your degree (e.g. an Indian bachelor's) is from a university where all instruction was in English; you self-declare this in the application, though documentation may be requested after you accept an offer.
english_waiver.quote: You earned a U.S. bachelor’s, master’s or doctoral degree, or international equivalent from a university where all instruction was conducted in English. | You will not be required to submit English proficiency test scores in the application if your responses on the Personal Background page reflect that you meet the above criteria; no additional documentation is required at the time of application.

notes: Each program sets its own GRE policy, and some (Chemistry, Earth System Science) set higher TOEFL/IELTS minimums. Fee waivers are school-based and need to be requested at least 10 business days before the program deadline.
